result.one_liner: Telegram is a messaging platform with a free REST API for building bots and accessing user messaging features.

evidence.quote: To log in as a bot, simply provide the bot token generated by @botfather.
Telegram supports the standard OpenID Connect protocol, allowing integration using any OIDC-compatible library or authentication platform.
The Telegram Bot Platform is free for both users and developers, and you are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.
All access is handled using a Bot Token generated via BotFather. The API development tools section lives under your my.telegram.org account settings.
Telegram Bot API is a REST API that is an HTTP-based interface for developers to build bots.
The Telegram Bot API documentation contains a description of the Bot API interface and a complete list of available classes, methods and updates.

result.notes: Telegram offers two main APIs: the Bot API (REST, free, token-based) for building bots, and the Client API (MTProto, free, API ID/Hash-based) for user applications. The Bot API is the most commonly used and fully documented public API with self-serve credentials. Both are completely free with no payment tiers or usage limits.
